**Windows:** unzip and run Duel Rush.exe (keep steam_api64.dll next to it) (More info -> Run anyway).
**Mac:** unzip, right-click Duel Rush -> Open (or System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Open Anyway).
**Linux / Steam Deck:** extract and run duel_rush (keep libsteam_api.so next to it); on a Deck, add it to Steam as a non-Steam game to play from Game Mode.

Players can play together when their games speak the same network version (shown in the game under Settings > Updates), even on different build numbers.
